title: fix(sdk): keep a File's name in upload()
author: Connectslide121

gist.summary: Fixed `@pollinations/sdk` so `upload(file)` keeps a `File`'s original name instead of sending every file as `upload`; `options.name` still takes precedence. This matches `transcribe()` and lets media.pollinations.ai use the filename to detect the media type when the uploaded part has no type. Bumped the SDK to `5.1.0-alpha.17`, added a changelog entry and a regression test; all 129 SDK tests pass.
